alt.en: Vectors u=[1,0] points right, v=[1,1] points diagonally up and right, and w=[-1,0] points left on shared coordinate axes. The diagonal has length square root of two, while u and w each have length one.
alt.zh-hans: 三支箭头从同一原点出发：u=[1,0] 朝右，v=[1,1] 朝右上，w=[-1,0] 朝左。v 长根号二，u 和 w 都长一。

caption.en: Figure 3.2 — Shared coordinates distinguish length from direction; the zero vector would remain at the origin.
caption.zh-hans: 图 3.2——在同一坐标系中比较长度和方向。零向量只对应原点，没有方向。
